title: Course Director UX UI and AI
description:
You've been designing long enough to have watched tools become essential and then disappear. You know which design skills are timeless and which ones expire.Â The human-centered design skills are where your heart is, and you know that AI will take over much of the tool-based design work soon.

You see the fear around AI, and you understand where it comes from. But you also see the opportunities, and you want to show people how to work with AI in a way that benefits their lives, their users, and the world.

You can name theÂ ten leading designersÂ who should be teaching the worldâs best courses and Master Classes right now. You know what each of them does better than anyone else, and where their gaps are.

Now you get the opportunity to decide what hundreds of thousands of designers learn next.

The industry leaders whose expertise you'll be turning into courses and Master Classes includeÂ Don Norman and Vitaly Friedman, as well as Design Leads atÂ Netflix, LinkedIn, Meta, and Adobe. Don Norman also chairs our executive board.

You'll be involved in the entire process of creating our courses and Master Classes, and you'll lead many of the decisions, so there are incredible opportunities for you toÂ take initiative, make meaningful contributions, and grow. Forget political struggles or long, pointless debates. Youâll be in a team with minimal distance between idea and action, where decisions are made ultra-fast.

Join the Global Leader in Online Design and AI Education

IxDF is the world's largest online design and AI education platform, with over 1,150,000 enrollments since 2002. We hold the trust of industry giants like Adobe, NASA, and IBM, who rely on our courses to train their teams. Prestigious universities, including MIT and the University of Cambridge, integrate our material into their curricula. Help us take online education to new heightsÂ andÂ make a meaningful impact on humankind.

At IxDF, weâre not just a company but a movement dedicated to making high-quality design and AI education accessible to everyone, everywhere.

We've pioneered online design education since 2002. We have over 1,150,000 enrollments and 1,583 company members, with more than 40 courses, 160 Master Classes, and thousands of open-source design resources, created by our team in collaboration with 240 industry leaders.

With learners from over 100 countries, your work will empower people worldwide.

We're Hiring Three People for Our Editorial Team

We're growing, and three roles are open at the same time to build the next generation of our core educational product. Here's what each role leads on:

  • Our Course Directors, UX, UI, and AI: lead what we teach and who teaches our courses and Master Classes. You reach out to industry leaders and create the invitation they say yes to. You bring your judgment to a planned course outline: what's missing, what doesn't belong, and whether the structure is solid. You plan and shoot courses with our Education Designers.Â This is the role described here.

  • Our Education Designers, UX, UI, and AI: lead how design and AI are taught. You plan, structure, and create the core content, and you decide what a course participant should be able to do by the end and how they get there.

  • Our Course Writers and Editors: lead how our courses and articles read. You make each title engaging, ensure each sentence flows, and edit the written course experience from the userâs perspective.

We're a flexible team, and you'll be able to do what you excel in. Everyone on our team creates courses, and everyone works across these roles. If you're torn between two roles, apply for the one you'd be best at, and tell us in your application which other one you considered and why.

You, the Course Director, decide what belongs in our curriculum and who should teach it. You reach out to the worldâs leading experts, plan the courses with them, and shoot courses with them. When an Education Designer brings you a course outline, you're the one who says what's missing, what doesn't belong, and how to optimize the learning outcome so designers can succeed today. You'll work closely with ourÂ Co-Founder, yourÂ Team Lead, our otherÂ Course Directors, and theÂ Education Designers, and you'll plan and create courses alongside them. Our Course Writers and Editors take the finished material the last mile: the scripts, hooks, headings, on-screen text in videos, quiz wording, and editorial voice. You'll also work closely with the video team and our growth team.

Your Role at IxDF

  • Be a core part of our Editorial Team. You'll collaborate with IxDF editors, video editors, and UX and UI designers as well as external industry leaders to create courses and Master Classes for people worldwide. You'll help them succeed in the age of AI with new skills in AI and in timeless human-centered design.

  • You'll research what already exists in a topic area, so that what we build is genuinely unique. You'll look atÂ where design and AI are heading, what designers needÂ that nobody has taught well yet, andÂ what we should retireÂ because the field has already moved on.

  • Find the people who should teach it.Â You decide a topic is worth a course, you work out who should teach it and why, you write the email, and you get the yes. Then you plan the content with the industry leader and agree what the course must leave a learner able to do.

  • Decide what each expert should teach.Â The best designers know a great deal, and a course that tries to capture all of it becomes an information dump. You develop a point of view on what a designer genuinely needs from them, and you hold the course to it.

  • You'll decide which skills our courses teach, both to people entering design and to experienced designers leveling up. Our goal is to help designers thrive in the age of AI and work responsibly, so their users can thrive too.

  • Ensure our course participants finish each course with a solid portfolio project they can show a hiring manager.

  • Help us decide what AI should do for our course participants. Personalized learning paths, constructive AI feedback on portfolio work, practice environments where people run real design tasks and get feedback. You'll also help us improve the user flows on our own platform, so that learning at IxDF is as well designed as what we teach. You'll work on this with our founders, designers, and dev team.

  • Make an impact as you pressure-test the coursesÂ our Education Designers plan. An Education Designer sends you a course outline, and you read it against everything you know about the field and about how people learn design, then give constructive feedback on what's missing, what doesn't belong, and where the structure can be improved.Â You know the limits of your own expertise, and you research your way past them before you weigh in. You'll also plan, structure, and create courses yourself, alongside them.

  • You're one of the peopleÂ whose judgment the rest of the team leans on.Â You show our Education Designers what ten or twenty years in the field taught you to look for. In return, our Co-Founder, your Team Lead, and our other Course Directors give constructive feedback on the courses you lead. You'll work in aÂ diverse, highly organized, result-driven environmentÂ where you'll grow personally and professionally.

  • Act as guardian of our quality bar. When a course goes out under our name, it has to be better than anything else available on the topic. On the courses and Master Classes you lead or review, you're the one who spots what's not good enough yet and works with the team to fix it.

  • Bring your subject matter expertiseÂ to our writers, community managers, and social media team, so our design thinking stays consistent across everything we publish.

  • You help produce Master Classes. We produce 3 per month. Over email, you reach out to designers whose work you admire, invite them to create one with us, plan the content, and produce the live session.Â Timelines vary enormously:Â with Don Norman or Vitaly Friedman it can be two weeks from first email to publication, because we work with them often. With a new expert, it can be half a year. Once the session is recorded, you get the footage and the transcript, and you decide with the Education Designers and Team Lead which existing course benefits from which snippets, and where they go.

  • Focus on what mattersÂ as you take raw expert video material, course and Master Class transcripts and footage featuring global industry leaders, and turn it into educational material that teaches new skills in AI and in timeless human-centered design. You'll work across UX design, human-computer interaction, design thinking, UI design, psychology, and AI.

  • Design for a diverse, global audience.Â Some of our courses and Master Classes serve working designers who want to grow into more senior work. Others serve people moving into design from other fields. Often, a course will serve both in the same lesson. Getting both right without watering either down is a rewarding design challenge.

  • Give the video teamÂ constructive feedbackÂ on course and Master Class videos, from on-screen text and b-roll to graphics and animation, so each video is engaging to learn from and accurate from a design perspective.

  • Fly out and meet the global industry leaders in design in professional studios across the world.Â You'll shoot the course content there with some of your colleagues. Expect this a few times a year at minimum. Some of us love that part and join every studio production; others keep it to those few trips. Both work for us. On averageÂ we shoot 4-6 new courses per year.

  • Expect to have several courses moving at once at different stages: one you're planning with an expert, one being shot, one in production, and one published course that you're reviewing and improving.

  • Find room for improvementÂ by looking at completion rates, learner feedback, and the portfolios course participants produce, then go back and fix what isn't excellent yet. Use the power of incremental, modular design as you help push the quality of our educational materials to new heights, surpassing even the very best in industry and academia. We're always learning, always improving, always raising the bar in everything we do and ship.

  • Maintain and improve our crystal-clear documentationÂ so our knowledge resources stay up-to-date, easy to find, and provide instant value to our internal teams. Clarity is key. Any line of documentation should be self-explanatory.

  • We're proud to have assembledÂ a remarkable team of unicornsÂ who uplift, motivate, and push each other to excel daily. There's a seat open for someone who shares our passion for excellence. Could that be you?

About You

  • You have at leastÂ 10 years of hands-on design experience. Thirty is not too many.

  • You have aÂ network among designers you respect, and you'reÂ comfortable writing to someone you admireÂ and presenting them with an opportunity.

  • You know what the design community wants to see, and what it needs to learn.

  • You're kind, and you have theÂ social intelligence and empathy toÂ engage well with very different kinds of people. Much of this job is convincing busy, accomplished people that what we're building is worth their time.

  • You can show us something you built or led: a product, a design team, a course, an AI teaching app, or a conference track. We're excited to hear what it was, your thinking behind it, how long it took you to create, what went wrong, and how you improved it.

  • You can take aÂ broad, complex design practice and turn it into a step-by-step learning sequenceÂ that'll make a beginner feel and act confident. You can look at a plan for teaching something andÂ see what's missingÂ before anyone builds it.

  • You're aÂ practical idealist. You know how to create great results through incremental quick wins and MVPs, and you know when to go all in and make something perfect.

  • Youâre aÂ forward thinkerÂ who isnât afraid to innovate and try new things before others have.

  • YouÂ collaborate with AI in everything you do. You use AI to research, structure, write, and create faster, and you know how to takeÂ human leadership, so theÂ outcome is 100% yoursÂ and better than you could have created without AI.

  • YouâreÂ eager to help people build UX and UI skillsÂ because you know theyâre more relevant than ever in the age of AI.

  • You canÂ teach a career changerÂ the powerful skills of great design, and you canÂ guide an experienced designerÂ in upskilling. Perhaps you've mentored people, or youâve run your own company helping clients level up.

  • YouÂ give constructive feedback people can act on, and you can tell a talented colleague how they can improve their work without them becoming defensive.

  • You're genuinelyÂ curiousÂ about how AI is changing design work and design education.

  • You'reÂ fluent in written and spoken EnglishÂ and you can explain complex ideas clearly.

  • Youâre enthusiastic about learning by doing and areÂ committed to putting in the effort to continuously improve your skills.

  • YouÂ spot problemsÂ before anyone else notices them, and when something goes off track you come back with a solution rather than a report.

  • YouÂ value teamwork, prioritize collaboration, and focus on collective goals and harmony in the workplace.

  • You'reÂ self-motivated, and you loveÂ creative freedom,Â independent judgment, and theÂ responsibilityÂ that comes with both.

  • Youâre driven by the desire toÂ make a positive impact in the worldÂ and to improve the lives of others.

  • If you still love designing in Figma and building interfaces with AI, there's room for that here. Some of our Course Directors design hands-on; others have moved fully into direction. Both work for us.

  • Most of the work happens from yourÂ home office,Â but you'reÂ willing to travel a few times a yearÂ to shoot courses.

  • You're located in aÂ time zoneÂ between UTC-6 (Austin, Chicago) and UTC+8 (Singapore, Perth), which includes all of Europe.

Bonus Points

None of these are required, but each of them would make us even happier.

  • You'veÂ led a design team.

  • YouÂ publish your own thinking on design: articles, a book, educational material, a blog, or a social media presence.

  • You'veÂ spoken at design conferences, or you're on a first-name basis with people who do.

  • You'veÂ created design systems. Organizing complex material so other people can put it to use is a lot of what you'll be doing.

  • You've worked as anÂ editor, or you've createdÂ online courses.

  • You have the graphic design skills to create image-based and interactive content for courses, articles, and social media.

  • You'veÂ built AI-supported learning toolsÂ yourself, or you've used AI to build products.

  • You hold aÂ bachelor's or master'sÂ degree in UX, UI, HCI,Â AI, or a similar field.

  • YouâveÂ collaborated with video production teams.

What We Can Offer

  • A highly valued role: You'll shape our core product, our courses and Master Classes.

  • Reach and impact that are difficult to find anywhere else in this field.Â A design leader might shape the work of thirty people on their team. Your decisions about what we teach will reach hundreds of thousands. They'll build better careers and design a better world for all of us.

  • Access:Â the designers you'd normally see on a conference stage are the people you'll email, plan with, and sit across from in a studio. Our name opens doors. An email from IxDF gets read, so the reach you have now is the floor, not the ceiling.

  • Autonomy: Nobody will ever hand you a template and tell you to fill it in.

  • A global, purpose-driven team: work remotelyÂ alongside passionate professionals from all over the world, united by aÂ common missionÂ to create the best possible design and AI education in the world and make it accessible for everyone.

  • Our co-founder and co-CEO, Rikke, will work closely with you. She and our other co-founder, Mads, built IxDF from nothing, with no investment capital, so we would stay free to make world-class design education affordable to everyone. She was the sole editor and video editor for many of our early years, so she's shaped our course planning, expert interviews, video shoots, and content editing from the inside. She's still hands-on in everything we do, and she still films educational videos herself, in places like the US, the North Pole, and Nepal.

  • AÂ full-time positionÂ within a fully remote organization. Video-based collaboration with your colleagues from elsewhere on the planet, and we get together in person each year, on a team trip or for a studio production.

  • Bi-weeklyÂ knowledge-sharing sessionsÂ and 4 meeting-free days weekly for focused work.

  • A work culture with noÂ fluffy titles, political agendas, or corporate drama. Your colleagues valueÂ your warm character, your strong work ethic, and the results you deliver. If you embody old-school virtues of always striving to deliver results, learn and become better every day, you'll thrive at IxDF.

  • A daily mission to help impact,Â empower, and enrich the lives of millions of peopleÂ by creatingÂ affordable high-end design educationÂ for everyone across the planet. It'll be yours too.

  • Colleagues with four to forty years of experience, and a culture where we follow the best idea, not the longest rÃ©sumÃ©.

  • A companyÂ where the distance between idea and execution is minimal.Â We're a highly agile organization withÂ zero bureaucracy or corporate politicsÂ â and withÂ exceptional order and efficiency.

  • A company culture whereÂ passion meets high performance and excellence. To help us improve the world, and yourself in the process,Â you'll need grit, strong work ethic, long-term thinking, and self-discipline.

  • We thrive because we have aÂ hands-on attitude and a bias towards actionÂ as opposed to fluff-filled, unrealistic strategies. You'll needÂ crisp execution skills yourselfÂ and the ability toÂ impress your colleagues with concrete results, just like they'll impress you.

  • We built online design education before people believed in it. AI is now changing what designers do, and they carry a bigger responsibility than ever. You'll be at theÂ forefront of teaching designers to work with AI and to design responsibly for it. You'll helpÂ set a directionÂ that shapes both the designers we teach and the people who use what they build. Together, we'll design a better world.

You'd join an autonomous, cross-functional squad — a Product Owner, backend and frontend engineers, plus data & UX partners and principal engineers who've built this engine at scale.   • Support our CI/CD environment and produce a positive impact with each release
  • Support our agile, flexible, team-oriented development to bring the search product to the next level

About You

  • Bachelor's in Computer Science, Information Systems, or relevant industry experience

  • Solution-oriented attitude with a focus on materializing the business vision through technical means

  • Experience with database management systems such as MySQL or similar relational databases

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with Redis and Terraform

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!

At Flix, we empower our teams to push boundaries and shape the future of mobility. As we continue to scale globally, we harness cutting-edge technology to make mobility smarter, more sustainable, and more affordable.

If you're looking for a place where you can drive change and redefine how millions of people travel, Flix is the place where you can lead your journey!

title: Senior Product Manager (Giftcard)

title: Multiphysics Simulation Engineer
description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO

  • Shape the architecture of the world’s first commercial fusion power plant – Own system-level decisions that determine how a first-of-a-kind energy technology is designed, integrated, and ultimately deployed at scale.

  • Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges – Work across tightly coupled disciplines (plasma physics, magnets, cryogenics, manufacturing, controls, and more) to resolve critical trade-offs and turn cutting-edge science into a functioning product.

  • Design real hardware with a pragmatic, fast-moving team from all over the world – Combine advanced simulation and systems thinking with a strong execution mindset, focusing on practical engineering solutions that accelerate the path to commercial fusion energy.

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

  • You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world.

  • You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals.

  • Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey.

  • Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent.

YOUR IMPACT

Alpha will be the first stellarator to achieve net energy. Getting there requires building a deeply coupled machine, where plasma, magnets, structures, cryogenics, heating work as one, and work at the edge of what each discipline can deliver on its own. You will own the complex calculations that set the requirements each system needs to be designed against. You will be accountable for providing the engineering design teams with reasonably estimated and correctly validated load cases that drive the design of the machine.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Own simulation pipelines end to end. From physics assumptions through to the machine-defining load cases you provide the subsystem to teams. You own the whole chain, not a step in it.

  • Build the simulators. Finite-element models where that's the right instrument, a reduced-order model coded from scratch where it isn't, all of it properly interfaced with our codebase.

  • Set the interfaces. Define with each engineering team what goes in, what comes out, what it means and what it doesn't cover.

  • Scan the space. Run parameter sweeps and simulation campaigns at scale to settle machine-level tradeoffs before they're locked in.

  • Prove the numbers. Benchmark, cross-check against analytical limits and experiment, and know the boundary where your model stops being trustworthy.

title: Product Manager (parental leave cover)
description:
About Tandem

Tandem is the leading global language learning community, with over 35 million members from all around the world practicing languages together. The concept of learning from each other is not only core to the Tandem community, it is also at the heart of how we work every day at Tandem.


We are based in Berlin, profitable and growing, and backed by top European investors. We are highly international and driven by a shared passion for languages, technology, and culture. Together, we are on a mission to connect the world through languages, by building a product that helps people not just learn, but truly understand each other across cultures.


We are looking for a bright, data-driven, collaborative operator to help us improve the experience of our members. 


Your role will be to:

  • Run the experiment loop: hypothesis, spec, launch, readout, ship or kill. Keep a steady cadence of live tests.

  • Find the next bets from data, research, and member feedback - not from a backlog of random ideas.

  • Spec and land a small number of features with design and engineering; you are accountable for the outcome, not the ticket.

  • Share results in a way the rest of Tandem can act on.


You are the right fit for the role if you:

  • Have 3+ years of product management experience, including consumer mobile apps at scale.

  • Are analytical: you know the metrics that matter, can reason about experiments and statistical results, and are fluent in product analytics.

  • Have a proactive, independent way of working, with leadership and ownership you can point to - not only ideas, but things you shipped.

  • Are a clear communicator and a strong collaborator, with excellent written and spoken English.

  • Care about simple, intuitive user experiences and can work closely with design to get there.

  • Like hard problems and stay with them until they are solved.

  • Use AI in your own work to move faster, and are thoughtful about where it belongs in product operations.


The benefits


Passion for languages: 

We’re a team of 30 people speaking 20 languages fluently between us. For those wanting to improve their German (or Denglisch!), you can join one of our German classes on us.


Take a deep dive: 

As a Tandem team member, we’ll give you a budget for up to 6 “Deep Dive Days” per year. Pick a topic you’ve always wanted to explore for your professional development that has never made it out of your backlog. Then book a cabin in the woods or whatever matches your individual learning style.


Teams who train together, stay together: 

We offer Urban Sports Club gym memberships to boost our team’s physical and mental health. If you prefer, we can contribute to your monthly public transport ticket instead.


It takes a team to Tandem: 

Bonding with our teammates outside of our normal work routine is important to us. We organize regular team events: from day trips to monthly lunches, summer BBQs, and movie nights.


Balance matters: 

Life isn’t just about work. We know when to snooze Slack notifications, recharge our batteries, and take time out for our personal hobbies. As home office has become the new normal for some of us, it’s even more important to be able to switch off from work and relax.


Modern family: 

As part of our family-friendly company philosophy, we embrace flexible working hours, welcome families to our events, and love for our kids to visit the office and get a taste of life at Tandem.


Relocation without the stress: 

If you’re looking to relocate to Berlin, we’re ready to assist you with the infamous German bureaucracy. Many of us have been through it before, so we have plenty of tips to share. You’ll feel settled in no time.


Hybrid by design: 

We’re all about embracing a flexible, modern way of working. That’s why we focus on a hybrid approach—balancing time between our vibrant Berlin-Mitte office and the comfort of your home. It’s the best of both worlds, and we’ll support you in creating the perfect setup for this dynamic way of working.

title: (Senior) Customer Success Manager (m/w/d) – B2B SaaS / eCommerce – Berlin, München, Pforzheim (Hybrid)
description:
Introduction

Als (Senior) Customer Success Manager (m/w/d) übernimmst Du bei FactFinder ein eigenes Portfolio namhafter eCommerce-Kunden und verantwortest deren Entwicklung von Adoption und Value Realization bis zu Renewal und Expansion.

Dabei arbeitest Du mit anspruchsvollen Mid-Market-, Enterprise- und Strategic Accounts – B2B- wie B2C-Unternehmen aus den unterschiedlichsten Branchen – und bewegst Dich souverän zwischen operativen eCommerce-Teams, technischen Ansprechpartnern und C-Level-Stakeholdern.

FactFinder ist eine der führenden Product-Discovery-Plattformen für den europäischen eCommerce. Über 2.000 Kunden wie Douglas und SPAR erzielen mit unserer KI-gestützten Produktsuche einen Gesamt-GMV von mehr als 160 Milliarden Euro pro Jahr.

Auf einen Blick

  • Kundenportfolio: ca. 40–50 Accounts – überwiegend Mid-Market, ergänzt um Enterprise- und Strategic Accounts, vorwiegend im DACH-Markt
  • Kommerzielle Verantwortung: Upsell- und Expansion-Ziele sowie Churn-Prävention und Vermeidung von Downgrades – die kommerzielle Ownership liegt bei Dir als CSM
  • Standorte: Berlin, München oder Pforzheim – hybrid mit 2–3 Office-Tagen pro Woche
  • Team & Reporting: CS-Team mit klar definierten Senioritätsleveln, Reporting an die Director Customer Success

Über FactFinder
Seit über 20 Jahren entwickelt FactFinder KI- und Machine-Learning-Technologie für Produktsuche, Navigation, Personalisierung und Produktempfehlungen im Online-Handel. Mit unserer Product Discovery Experience (PDX), dem Investor Genui im Rücken und einem neuen Management-Team starten wir in die nächste Wachstumsphase. Rund 90 Kolleginnen und Kollegen arbeiten an unseren Standorten in Pforzheim, Berlin, München und Stockholm.


Your mission

  • Portfolio & Customer Value: Du verantwortest ca. 40–50 Mid-Market-, Enterprise- und Strategic Accounts, überwiegend im DACH-Markt – B2B- und B2C-Kunden aus den unterschiedlichsten Branchen, was die Rolle besonders abwechslungsreich macht. Gemeinsam mit Deinen Kunden definierst Du klare Ziele und Success-Pläne und machst den Mehrwert von FactFinder anhand relevanter KPIs messbar.
  • Retention & Churn-Prävention: Du erkennst anhand von Produktnutzung, Adoption und Kundenfeedback frühzeitig Risiken und leitest proaktiv Maßnahmen ein. Die kommerzielle Renewal-Verantwortung liegt bei Dir – mit starker Unterstützung durch unser Sales Operations Team. Da sich unsere Verträge in der Regel automatisch verlängern, liegt Dein Fokus auf Churn-Prävention und der Vermeidung von Downgrades.
  • Upsell & Expansion: Du verantwortest Expansion in Deinem Portfolio end-to-end – von der Identifikation der Opportunity bis zum kommerziellen Abschluss, aktuell punktuell noch mit Unterstützung durch Sales. Du hast ein eigenes, portfolioabhängiges Expansion-Ziel, das direkt in Deinen variablen Anteil einfließt.
  • Business Reviews & Enablement: Du moderierst QBRs und Workshops, begleitest Feature-Rollouts und Pilotprojekte und sorgst dafür, dass Deine Kunden FactFinder erfolgreich einsetzen.
  • Voice of the Customer: Du verstehst Herausforderungen und Anforderungen Deiner Kunden und übersetzt sie in klare Impulse für Product und Product Marketing. Dabei arbeitest Du eng mit Sales, Consulting und Support zusammen.
  • Aufbau statt Verwaltung: Du entwickelst Playbooks, Prozesse, Reporting und KI-gestützte Workflows weiter und gestaltest unsere Customer-Success-Strukturen aktiv mit. Salesforce bildet die Grundlage für Deine datenbasierte Account-Steuerung.

So arbeitest Du im Team
Du übernimmst Deine Kunden ab Vertragsunterschrift von Sales und begleitest sie über den gesamten Customer Lifecycle. Im Alltag arbeitest Du am engsten mit unseren Business- und Technical-Consulting-Teams zusammen, die Dich beim Onboarding, bei Integrationen und bei komplexeren Fragestellungen unterstützen. Unser Service Desk übernimmt operative Tickets und Nutzungsfragen. So kannst Du Dich voll auf die strategische und kommerzielle Entwicklung Deiner Accounts konzentrieren.


Your profile

Must-have: 

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der eigenständigen Betreuung anspruchsvoller B2B-SaaS-Kunden im Customer Success, Account Management oder einem kundenorientierten SaaS-, Digital- oder Technology-Consulting-Umfeld.Erfahrung mit Mid-Market- und/oder Enterprise-Kunden und komplexen Stakeholder-Strukturen bis zur C-Level-Ebene.
  • Technisches Produktverständnis: Du verstehst Produktfunktionen, Konfigurationslogiken, APIs, Integrationen und Datenflüsse so weit, dass Du Kunden auch inhaltlich beraten und mit Product- und Consulting-Teams auf Augenhöhe arbeiten kannst. Selbst entwickeln musst Du nicht.
  • Value- und kommerzielles Denken: Du übersetzt Kundenziele in messbare Outcomes, erkennst Churn-Risiken und Wachstumspotenziale und verstehst, wie Customer Success auf Retention und Expansion einzahlt.
  • Routinierter Umgang mit CRM-Systemen, idealerweise Salesforce.
  • Deutsch und Englisch fließend sowie Reisebereitschaft innerhalb DACH je nach Kundenbedarf.

Nice-to-have:
  • Erfahrung mit eCommerce-Technologien wie Site Search, Product Discovery, Recommendation Engines, Personalisierung, PIM oder Feed Management.
  • Erfahrung im Aufbau skalierbarer Customer-Success-Prozesse sowie mit KI-gestütztem Arbeiten.
  • eCommerce- oder Search-Erfahrung ist kein Muss. Entscheidend sind Deine B2B-SaaS-Erfahrung, Dein technisches Verständnis und Deine Fähigkeit, messbaren Customer Value zu schaffen.


THE JOY OF WORKING WITH US

  • Attraktives Vergütungsmodell: fixer und erfolgsabhängiger Anteil – Dein variabler Anteil honoriert Churn-Prävention und Expansion-Erfolge in Deinem Portfolio direkt.
  • Produkt mit messbarem Impact: Unsere Kunden sehen den Effekt von FactFinder direkt in Conversion Rate und Umsatz – Du kannst den Erfolg Deiner Arbeit konkret sichtbar machen.
  • Starke Brands & echte Verantwortung: Du arbeitest mit bekannten B2B- und B2C-Unternehmen aus den unterschiedlichsten Branchen – vom Mid-Market bis zum Strategic Account.
  • Gestaltungsspielraum: Unsere Customer-Success-Organisation entwickelt sich weiter. Du übernimmst nicht nur bestehende Prozesse, sondern kannst Playbooks, Reporting und Arbeitsweisen aktiv mitgestalten.
  • Entwicklungsperspektive: Klar definierte Senioritätslevel im CS-Team – je nach Stärke und Interesse entwickelst Du Dich in Richtung strategischer Enterprise Accounts oder People Leadership.
  • Arbeitsumfeld & Benefits: Salesforce, Notion, Gong, Slack und KI-gestützte Workflows sowie 2–3 Office-Tage/Woche, 30 Urlaubstage, modernes Equipment, Mobilitätsangebote, betriebliche Altersvorsorge und weitere relevante Benefits.Bewerbungsprozess

title: Game Data Analyst (f/m/d)
description:
We are Kolibri Games - a mobile games developer from Berlin. We believe that with the best people, we can make games that players will enjoy for years to come.

Our games have defined the idle genre, and bring enjoyment to hundreds of millions of players all around the world. This is possible due to the talented people who make us who we are. ‘Kolibris’, as we call ourselves, are on a mission to continue making great games and we're looking for new talent to join our team. We strive to offer you a fair recruitment process and a great candidate experience, as well as a friendly environment to work in, with plenty of opportunities to learn and grow.

Game Data Analyst (f/m/d)
Are you curious about what makes games engaging? Do you enjoy understanding not just what players do, but why they do it, and turning that understanding into clear, actionable insights?
We are looking for a Game Data Analyst to strengthen our product analytics capabilities. In this role, you will combine strong analytical thinking with solid technical foundations to support multiple game teams over time. 
This is an individual contributor role with a strong emphasis on data modeling, advanced analysis, and scalable analytical foundations.

Responsibilities
  • Partner with product and game teams to answer complex questions around player behavior, engagement, and progression
  • Perform advanced analyses using SQL to uncover patterns and drivers behind player actions
  • Design and analyze player segmentation and behavioral cohorts
  • Design, implement, and evaluate A/B tests to measure feature performance, optimize player experiences, and guide data-informed decisions.
  • Build and maintain reliable, analytics-ready data models (experience with dbt or similar tools)
  • Ensure data quality, clarity, and documentation of key datasets and metrics
  • Contribute to self-serve reporting and visualization
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to align priorities, influence roadmap decisions, and ensure analytics is central to shaping the player experience.
  • Collaborate with other analysts and data infrastructure team to improve analytical workflows and standards

    • Required Skills
  • 3+ years of experience in Data Analytics
  • Proficiency in SQL and data visualization tools
  • Experience working with complex datasets and analytical data models
  • Ability to translate data into clear insights for both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Curiosity, ownership, and eagerness to learn new tools and approaches

    • Desirable Skills
  • Experience with Looker and dbt
  • Experience with Python or R for data analysis.
  • Familiarity with data orchestration tools (e.g. Airflow)
  • Background in games, free-to-play, or product analytics
    • Kolibri Games is an equal opportunity employer. We come from 40 different countries and many different backgrounds. We celebrate diversity and we are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees, regardless of their age, gender identity, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, physical appearance or disability.

    We are an international studio, so don’t forget to send in your application in English. Although it is not mandatory, we always appreciate a cover letter stating your motivation to join us.

    We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Global Product Director
description:
Ready to lead, disrupt and reinvent the sleep industry?

We are Emma – The Sleep Company. Founded in 2015, we have grown into the world’s largest direct-to-consumer (D2C) sleep brand, with a presence in over 20 markets and more than 35 Emma stores across Europe. 

Our mission is simple: to develop sleep comfort products that empower our customers to awaken their best every day. Today, our products are trusted by millions and recommended by leading consumer associations worldwide. 

It’s our people who bring this mission to life. At Emma, you’ll join a driven, international team that values ownership, collaboration, and continuous knowledge sharing. With colleagues from over 70 nationalities, we combine diverse perspectives with a shared ambition to learn, grow, and create lasting impact, together. 

Ready to awaken your best with us? 

 

What you'll do:
  • Own category management and product development: range architecture, category prioritisation, lifecycle management, and pricing logic
  • Build and lead a high-performing, cross-functional product organisation (6 direct reports, 65 Emmies across two topics - category management and product development)
  • Build and execute a product strategy to make Emma the global leader in sleep across online and offline
  • Lead physical product development -materials, manufacturing, supplier relationships, and cost structures
  • Ground all product decisions in deep consumer understanding to drive satisfaction, brand preference, and word-of-mouth
  • Design a product architecture that balances global ambition with meaningful local differences
  • Act as a co-owner at Senior Leadership level - You will be directly reporting to the CEO and Co-founder Dennis and contributing to company strategy and cross-functional decisions
  • Think in P&L - defend margin, manage complexity, and prevent range proliferation
  • Build the processes and accountability structures that make the product org predictable and high-performing
  • Develop a strong layer of senior product leaders and invest in succession and capability-building

    • Who we are looking for:
  • 15+ years of relevant experience, with at least 3–4 years in a senior leadership role leading other team leaders
  • Deep expertise in category management - assortment strategy, range architecture, pricing logic, and portfolio decision-making
  • Hands-on experience in physical product development - materials, manufacturing, supplier relationships, cost structures
  • Background in branded consumer goods with proprietary R&D (not retail-only or pure trading)
  • Operationally deep - comfortable leading through doing, not just directing
  • Proven decision-maker under ambiguity, with the ability to give clarity when stakeholders pull in different directions
  • Experience at scale - 1,000+ people, multi-market, multi-category organisations
  • 12+ years of relevant experience, with at least 3–4 years in a senior leadership role leading other team leaders
  • Strong cross-functional collaborator who sees product as a platform for company-wide impact

    • What we offer:
  • The opportunity to create real impact, take ownership and accountability, and drive meaningful change.
  • Continuous learning and development through hands-on experience, mentoring, formal training, and access to tools such as our Learning Hub and Nilo.
  • A collaborative community of smart, driven people where you learn, contribute, and connect, every day and through team events.
  • A global environment, working daily with diverse perspectives across 4 offices and 70+ nationalities. 25 vacations days per year, with 1 extra day per year worked (until a limit of 30 days per year).

Besonders freuen wir uns über Erfahrung in Logistik, Operations oder Supply Chain sowie Kenntnisse in Stammdatenmanagement, Data Governance, SAP oder Salesforce. Diese Punkte sind jedoch keine zwingende Voraussetzung.

Wir suchen niemanden, der lediglich Aufgaben verwaltet oder vorgegebene Analysen abarbeitet. Wir suchen eine Persönlichkeit, die mitdenkt, Verantwortung übernimmt und gemeinsam mit uns und unseren Kunden anspruchsvolle Themen voranbringt.

About RoomPriceGenie ✨🧞‍♂️

Founded in 2017, RoomPriceGenie is dedicated to helping hoteliers around the globe achieve optimal pricing. 🌍 We understand that many small hotels face challenges with digitalization, making their operations increasingly complex and often resulting in lost revenue. This is where we come in!

We have developed a powerful solution that enables hotels to set the right prices in just seconds. ⏱️ Our state-of-the-art algorithm analyzes both internal hotel data and market trends to recommend pricing strategies that enhance revenue and improve booking rates.

With customers spanning the globe—from the USA and Canada to Iceland, South Africa, China, Slovenia, Italy, and the UK—RoomPriceGenie has made a meaningful impact in the hospitality industry, and our clients love the results. ❤️

Now, we are excited to expand our customer base and spread the word about how we can support hoteliers in optimizing their pricing strategies. We invite you to join us on this journey! We actively encourage applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds to enrich our team and drive innovation.

Why RoomPriceGenie?

We take both culture and product seriously: recognized as Best Place to Work in HotelTech (2026) and Best Revenue Management Software (2026). We power pricing for thousands of hotels worldwide on a modern data stack.

This is a fully remote role within Europe (UTC+0 to UTC+2). You will have genuine ownership, strong support, and the opportunity to build high-value internal AI systems and agents that make our operational teams significantly faster and smarter.

Your Role

As an AI Systems & Automation Engineer, you will drive internal AI adoption across Customer Success, Sales, and Operations. Your job isn't to build raw ML models or write throwaway demos. You will work directly with business leads to unblock legacy processes, connect internal data to core operational tools, and deploy dependable, supervised AI agents that automate complex workflows.

You will join our AI & Security team and bridge the gap between our core data platforms (Snowflake, Postgres, DocumentDB, S3) and our GTM stack (HubSpot, Chargebee, Modjo, Notion), establishing practical patterns for safe, agentic automation across the business.

What You’ll Do

  • Translate Business Pain into Systems: Partner directly with Customer Success, Sales, and Ops teams to map out manual, multi-step workflows and design high-ROI AI automation targets.

  • Build Production Agents & Integrations: Write clean, maintainable code (Python/TypeScript) connecting LLM APIs to internal data stores and third-party SaaS platforms (HubSpot, Chargebee, Modjo, Notion).

  • Implement Modern Agent Standards: Build modular agent capabilities using standardized tools and schemas (such as Agent Skills standards, Claude Plugins, or custom function-calling pipelines) to give models safe, structured action boundaries.

  • Design Human-in-the-Loop Workflows: Implement strict guardrails, schema validation, human approval gates, and escalation paths so non-technical staff can safely supervise AI outputs.

  • Ensure Integration Reliability: Manage API rate limits, Webhooks, asynchronous jobs, and retry logic to keep integrations rock-solid as internal data volume grows.

  • Measure & Iterate: Build lightweight evaluation harnesses to track agent accuracy, hallucination rates, latency, and cost, optimizing prompt architectures and model choices based on real production usage.

Your Profile

  • Strong Software Fundamentals: Solid background in Python and/or TypeScript, asynchronous execution, REST APIs, Webhooks, SQL, and working with relational or analytical databases.

  • Claude & LLM Ecosystem Expertise: Deep, hands-on proficiency with Claude (Anthropic API, Prompt Engineering, Workbench, SDKs) and adjacent modern developer applications.

  • Agent Skill & Tool Design: Familiarity with modern agent capability frameworks, such as standard Agent Skills (agentskills.io), Claude Plugins / Model Context Protocol (MCP), or structured tool execution design.

  • Integration & Ecosystem Familiarity: Experience consuming complex SaaS APIs (HubSpot, Chargebee, Modjo). Proficiency with Notion (APIs, workspace structures, and knowledge management) is a strong plus.

  • Operational Empathy: Business-minded engineer who enjoys talking to non-technical colleagues, understanding messy legacy processes, and building practical tools that make their daily jobs easier.

  • Location & Communication: Fluent in English and based in European time zones (UTC+0 to UTC+2).

What We Offer at RoomPriceGenie 💪

At RoomPriceGenie, we don’t just offer jobs; we offer an adventure! 🚀 Join us in an exciting startup atmosphere where you can grow your career while changing the world for tens of thousands of independent hoteliers. 🌍 Our global and diverse team is fueled by passion and a shared mission. We thrive in a culture that’s all about transparency, respect, and making a real impact together.

Here’s what you can expect when you become part of our Genie family:

  • Remote-First Model: Work from (almost!) anywhere. 🌍🧑‍💻 Some roles need you in a specific country or time zone — we'll always flag that in the job ad. And whenever you like, come co-work with us in Mannheim, Berlin, or Sydney. 🏢

  • One Team, One Vision, One Goal: We’re in this together! 🤝 Our Genies are laser-focused on our mission, collaborating to make magic happen. ✨ It’s no wonder we score a stellar 9.3 from our team members! 🌟

  • Epic Team Gatherings: Every year, we bring our global crew together 🌎 for a week of networking, brainstorming, and fun. 🎉 Plus, enjoy regular hangouts in our offices to keep the camaraderie alive.

  • Growth and Development: We’re all about lifelong learning! 📚 Level up your skills with personal and professional development opportunities. You’ll even snag up to three extra days off each year to focus on your growth. 📈

  • 5 Years? 5 Weeks! Stick with us, and we’ll reward your loyalty. After five years, you’ll earn an incredible five weeks of bonus vacation time 🏖️ to recharge and explore the world. 🌍

  • Birthday Celebrations: It’s your day, so take it off! 🎂 Celebrate your birthday the way you want, guilt-free.

  • Flexible Hours: We get it—life happens! ⏰ We offer flexible working hours to help you balance your work and personal life seamlessly.

  • Wellbeing Matters: Your mental health is a top priority. 🧘 Every Genie gets access to Headspace, the leading meditation app, to help you cultivate a happier, healthier, and more zen life. 🌿

  • BetterHelp Support: We also offer BetterHelp, a professional online therapy and counseling platform, giving you additional support whenever you need it.💛🧠

We kindly ask that recruitment agencies refrain from reaching out regarding this vacancy. Thank you for your understanding.

Compensation: €85K – €95K

title: Software Development Engineer III, Maps API
description:
Mapbox is the leading real-time location platform for a new generation of location-aware businesses. Mapbox is the only platform that equips organizations with the full set of tools to power the navigation of people, packages, and vehicles everywhere. More than 4 million registered developers have chosen Mapbox because of the platform’s flexibility, security and privacy compliance. Organizations use Mapbox applications, data, SDKs and APIs to create customized and immersive experiences that delight their customers. 

The Maps API team builds and maintains the applications and infrastructure responsible for creating and distributing Mapbox maps. Thousands of customers rely on our services to seamlessly handle billions of requests every day, scale in real-time to global events, and enable designers, developers, and analysts to make and share maps we’ve never dreamed of.

Delivering maps means delivering a model of the world that’s changing all the time and needs to automatically support the world’s edge cases – writing systems, fonts, local regulations, and global boundary disputes.

Our team maintains the highest-traffic read APIs at Mapbox and the distributed ETL pipelines used by internal and external customers to turn data into maps. We’re building new ways for people to visualize location data. Check out our Mapbox maps!

As AI becomes embedded in modern engineering workflows, we value engineers who can thoughtfully integrate AI into design, development, and decision-making. Our interview process will include discussion of how you use AI in your engineering workflow.

What You’ll Do

As a Software Development Engineer III on the Maps API team, you will be responsible for balancing rapid development of new mapping tools against the reliability of our services as they scale into new request volumes, markets, and use cases. In a single week on the Maps API team, you might write application code robust to a world’s worth of data, build and deploy microservices, diagnose complex system behavior as global markets drive traffic in unexpected ways, or facilitate continuous delivery at Mapbox.

In this role, you can expect to:

  • Lead your engineering team to identify and scope out well-defined tasks.

  • Execute on the scope and be accountable for delivering on time with quality.

  • Design systems and make architectural decisions that will keep pace with the rapid growth of Mapbox’s customer base.

  • Mentor your peers through 1:1s, facilitating design and code reviews, and providing continuous guidance to foster professional growth and technical excellence.

  • Promote a culture of operational excellence by meticulously testing and monitoring our systems and code, writing documentation, and being on-call to support the health of our services.

  • Reduce technical debt, share your knowledge, and invest in your teammates’ health and happiness, while optimizing application performance and accelerating feature velocity.

  • Uphold a culture of collaboration, transparency, creativity, inclusion, and data-driven decisions.

What We Believe are Important Traits for This Role

  • 8-10+ years of experience building scalable high volume low latency backend services.

  • Proficiency with Python, NodeJS, and native AWS (CDK, ECS, Step Functions, Lambda, S3, RDS, CloudWatch, CloudFront).

  • Experience building mapping and geospatial related products.

  • Familiarity with code versioning tools, such as GitHub.

  • Able to perform independently all the development tasks, based on designs and specs.

  • Self-starter who is communication and outcomes-oriented.

  • An empirical analytical approach. You develop strong hypotheses, conduct spikes, and clearly communicate your findings.

  • A desire to share your expertise through documentation, mentorship, pairing, and both written and verbal discussion.

  • A desire to work with and lead individuals with diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences.

  • High quality mindset -- write unit tests, proactively remedy defects and follow through to production.

Nice to Have Traits for This Role

  • Proficiency in C++

What We Value

In addition to our core values, which are not unique to this position and are necessary for Mapbox leaders:

  • We value high-performing creative individuals who dig into problems and opportunities.

  • We believe in individuals being their whole selves at work. We commit to this through supportive health care, parental leave, flexibility for the things that come up in life, and innovating on how we think about supporting our people.

  • We emphasize an environment of teaching and learning to equip employees with the tools needed to be successful in their function and the company.

  • We strongly believe in the value of growing a diverse team and encourage people of all backgrounds, genders, ethnicities, abilities, and sexual orientations to apply.

How we support you

  • Hybrid/Remote Options: Enjoy flexibility to work comfortably from home or periodically from an office where applicable.

  • Country-Specific Care & Coverage: Private health, dental, and income protection plans tailored to elevate your regional statutory benefits.

  • Family-First Support: Family care, maternity and paternity leave policies to support your growing family.

  • Lifestyle Spending Account: Contributions to support your health, wellness, and personal growth

  • Balance & Brainpower: Mental health support for you and your dependents.

  • Rest & Recharge: Paid time away, company holidays, and generous absence policies.

  • Time Off to Give Back: Dedicated paid volunteering time in addition to your standard PTO.

By applying for this position, you acknowledge that you have received the Mapbox Non-US Privacy Notice for applicants, which is linked here. Completing this application requires you to provide personal data, such as your name and contact information, which is mandatory for Mapbox to process your application.

We are committed to a fair and equitable hiring process. We do not discriminate against any protected class.

title: Software Engineer, Backend - Core/API & Process Automation
description:
Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the role:

Backend engineering rarely gets this consequential. As a Software Engineer on Camunda's Core / API & Process Automation team, you'll work on the beating heart of Camunda 8 — the event-sourced, distributed workflow engine that executes business-critical processes for thousands of customers and, through them, millions of people worldwide. Because you sit at the core, one well-made improvement propagates outward through every integration and product built on top of it: a small change here is felt everywhere.

Few systems demand this. You'll dig into the performance of the hot paths, into versioning strategies for an engine that must faithfully replay every event it has ever written — forever, and into the concurrency between the engine advancing a process and a user mutating that same process in the same instant. And the bar is unforgiving: data must never be corrupted, and a process must never get stuck — because when it does, customers lose money. This is genuine distributed-systems work — event sourcing, ordering, concurrency, replay — not another CRUD app.

You'll also help build what comes next — including enabling AI agents to drive the engine, cutting-edge work that stretches what the industry thinks automation can do. You'll do it alongside a world-spanning team of highly skilled, highly motivated engineers who share one goal: make Camunda the best workflow engine in the world. And this is where you grow fast: you'll own well-scoped work end-to-end, deliberately take on unfamiliar and uncomfortable problems to stretch yourself, and learn from senior engineers you work beside every day — with everything shipping in the open (Zeebe is open source).

Curious about the kind of challenges you'll work on at Camunda? Watch this quick 30-minute talk from our engineers to learn more about the new Camunda Exporter and how we’re solving complex problems at scale

What You’ll Be Doing:

  •  Build and evolve features in the event-sourced engine and its C8 REST/gRPC/MCP API (command/event, CQRS), with guidance on the harder design calls.

  • Own well-scoped work end-to-end — implement, test, and ship; contribute your ideas to solution designs and write clear design notes / ADRs.

  • Help ship high-impact engine features — like suspending and resuming individual process instances, enabling AI agents to steer running processes, and variable tracing — and watch them reach thousands of customers.

  • Design and consume clean APIs — good contracts, developer ergonomics, and an awareness of not breaking existing integrations.

  • Detect and optimize inefficient processing and data-access patterns across our data stores (RocksDB, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, relational/Postgres) — growing into the harder cases — and build observability into what you ship.

  • Proactively flag issues and tech debt, keep quality high through reviews and testing (collaborative, not a lone hero), and participate in support / on-call as you ramp.

Must Haves:

  • Ability and/or willingness to use our product

  • 2+ years professional backend engineering experience.

  • Solid grasp of event-driven systems and genuine eagerness to go deep on event sourcing / distributed systems — including a working understanding of consistency, ordering, and failure basics.

  • Good API design instincts (REST) — clean, sensible contracts, with awareness of backward compatibility.

  • Product thinking — you care about the outcome for users, not just the ticket.

  • Strong "manager of one" — own your work and drive it forward without day-to-day management, manage your own time and focus in a remote/async setting, communicate progress and raise blockers early (self-directed, but knows when to ask for help), and reliably follow through on what you commit to.

  • High growth drive — genuinely ambitious to level up, and actively takes on unfamiliar, uncomfortable challenges rather than staying in the comfort zone.

  • Clear written communication in a remote-first, async setting.

 Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience with workflow automation / process orchestration (BPMN or similar).

  • Comfort reasoning about query patterns in Elasticsearch/OpenSearch and relational/Postgres.

  • Familiarity with observability (logging, metrics, tracing).

  • Working JVM knowledge.

What We Have to Offer:

Compensation

We offer competitive, fair, and transparent compensation. Salary ranges are location-based, with Standard and Major markets (global tech hubs) reflecting local competition.

The Annual Total Target Cash (base salary + 100% variable target, where applicable) shown below spans from the minimum in a Standard market to the maximum in a Major market. Final offers depend on skills, experience, and location, and we typically hire in the first half of the range to allow room for growth:

  • United States: $119,900.00 to $193,200.00

  • United Kingdom: £75,300.00 to £123,800.00

  • Singapore: S$148,900.00 to S$223,300.00

If you’re based elsewhere, you’ll be hired via Remote.com (our global employer partner), and your Talent Acquisition Partner will provide a personalized Total Rewards Calculator after your first interview.

Equity: We also offer equity (where applicable) through our Virtual Stock Option Plan (VSOP).

Benefits & Perks

We invest in your wellbeing, growth, and ability to connect, along with perks that support you no matter where you’re based. Our benefits are globally designed and locally delivered where applicable.

  • Remote & Flexible: Work from anywhere with the setup that suits you, home office budget, co-working space support, and flexible time off to recharge when you need it.

  • In Person Connection: We invest in meaningful face time through our Annual Kickoff (Vienna in 2025, Madrid in 2026!), team offsites, and Camundi Connection Budgets, including contributing to meetups while travelling,, and local gatherings with fellow Camundi.

  • Health & Wellbeing: Access locally tailored healthcare, Modern Health for global mental wellbeing, and our Live Well Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA), a flexible, global benefit that puts you in control of your whole life, not just work, from: staying active, to caring for family, exploring personal passions, meaningful experiences, and investing in your financial wellbeing. The Live Well program launches in 2026 and scales to €1,000 annually from 2027.

  • Financial Security: Retirement and pension plans (often with company contributions), plus life and disability insurance where relevant.

  • Professional Growth: Up to $/€/£1,000 per year for self-driven learning: courses, certifications, books, you decide!

AI in our hiring process: Camunda may use AI tools to aid the screening of applications and during the interview process. You can learn more here

”Everyone is welcome at Camunda” — it’s a celebrated component of our culture. We strive to create an inclusive environment that empowers our people. At Camunda, we honour diverse cultures and backgrounds and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, religion, belief, sexual orientation, age, disability or any other protected characteristics under applicable law. We are looking forward to your application!

Come join us and be part of Camunda’s incredible journey: Make an impact at a pivotal moment in our story!

Please be aware that scammers may impersonate Camunda by reaching out about job opportunities. Camunda will only contact candidates from an email address ending in @camunda.com. title: CAD & PLM Administration Intern
description:

Role overview

As a CAD & PLM Administration Intern, you will work closely with our engineering, CAD, PLM, and IT teams to help keep our design data and product lifecycle processes organised, accessible, and efficient.

Your primary focus will be supporting the creation and continuous improvement of a standard part library for CAD users. You will also act as a first point of contact for basic user requests and help create clear, practical documentation that enables our engineering teams to work effectively in a fast-paced aerospace environment.

This is an excellent opportunity to gain practical experience in CAD data management, PLM administration, engineering processes, and technical support while contributing to the development of a real space vehicle.

CAD and PLM administration

  • Support the creation, organisation, and maintenance of structured CAD and PLM data.

  • Support the setup and maintenance of CAD templates, standard part libraries, drafting standards, preferences, and other engineering environment settings.

  • Work with engineers and designers to identify opportunities to improve CAD workflows, data quality, reuse, and user experience.

  • Assist with testing and documenting changes to CAD and PLM processes, configurations, and system settings.

  • Gain hands-on experience with Siemens NX administration, including configuration concepts, customer defaults, role-based settings, templates, and environment configuration.

  • Learn about Siemens NX customization and automation possibilities under the guidance of experienced team members, for example through journals, reusable tools, interface settings, or workflow improvements.

Documentation and process support

  • Create and maintain user guides, how-to instructions, process descriptions, and FAQs.

  • Document CAD and PLM procedures in a clear and accessible way.

  • Support the preparation of training material for new and existing users.

General CAD and PLM administration and support

  • Assist with routine administration and monitoring tasks in the CAD and PLM environment under supervision.

  • Support users and create documentation based on frequent support requests

  • Work with engineering, PLM, CAD, and IT colleagues to improve data quality and user experience.

What we're looking for

Required

  • Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's programme in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

  • Good communication skills in English.

  • Basic experience with Siemens NX and strong interest in CAD, engineering data management, PLM, or technical systems administration.

  • Organised, detail-oriented, and comfortable working with structured data and technical information.

Nice to have

  • Basic familiarity with PLM concepts or systems such as Siemens Teamcenter.

  • Experience with C# and .Net, Powershell

  • Basic understanding of engineering drawing standards, part numbering, metadata, or configuration management.

  • Some exposure to Linux, IT infrastructure, databases, or technical support processes.

  • Interest in aerospace, spacecraft, or other complex technical environments.

title: Founding Solutions Architect
description:
About Zelara

Most CRM marketing still blasts generic messages at scale and calls it "personalization." Our founders experienced this firsthand in senior roles at HelloFresh, Salesforce, Uber, and others. Backed by top-tier VCs, they decided to build a better way.

Zelara is an agentic lifecycle marketing platform that improves with every interaction. It works with the CRM infrastructure our customers already use, replacing static journeys and manual segmentation with a system that creates content, makes individual-level decisions, and learns from every outcome.

With bunq, Europe's second-largest neobank, we delivered +7.4% activation and +66% reactivation uplift, measured against a control group. We raised a €3M pre-seed and are generating revenue with paying enterprise customers. Now we are hiring our first Solutions Architect to make the path from integration to measurable value repeatable.

The Role

This is a deeply technical customer role centered on post-sales value realization, with involvement in pre-sales discovery. It is not conventional customer success built around reactive support and business reviews, nor a pre-sales role that hands off at signature.

You will own technical value realization for a portfolio of customers, from discovery and onboarding through live experiments, measured results, and scaled adoption.

You and the commercial lead run each account as a pair, in a weekly rhythm and in the room together for the conversations that decide something. They own pricing, proposals, contracts, conversion to an annual contract, expansion, and renewal. You own the technical plan and evidence behind those decisions. Before signature, you lead technical discovery alongside them. After signature, you become the customer's named technical lead, accountable for solution design, data mapping, the experiment plan, stakeholder coordination, and go-live. You make value real and defensible; the commercial lead owns the close.

There is no separate customer success manager, and we are not planning one. The two of you hold the whole relationship: the commercial lead is the account owner, you are the technical owner, and the working relationship with the customer's CRM, data, and analytics teams is yours.

Your focus is the customer-specific application of Zelara's platform. Product owns the roadmap and prioritization. Engineering owns production software, reusable integrations, reliability, and security. Science owns the learning methods and models, experimental methodology, and causal measurement standards. You turn their work into a functioning customer solution and bring in each team when a requirement crosses those boundaries.

Today our founders lead the technical side of every customer relationship. You will take over that responsibility and build the function as the customer base grows.

You will work with mid-market and enterprise B2C companies across Europe: fintech, e-commerce, travel, and employee benefits. Successful pilots grow into long-term, scaled deployments.

What You Will Do

  • Own the technical customer journey from discovery through onboarding, pilot delivery, measured value, and scaled adoption

  • Lead technical discovery before signature: understand how the customer makes money and which metric moves it, then validate the integration path, available data, measurement feasibility, and what the pilot can credibly promise

  • Own onboarding: align stakeholders, define the data mapping and acceptance criteria, coordinate implementation, and take the customer live on its existing CRM stack

  • Design and pre-register each customer experiment using Zelara's scientific standards: hypothesis, primary metric, cohort, control group, conversion window, success threshold, and decision rules, because a success bar set after seeing the data is not a result

  • Own the customer-facing interpretation of results: reconcile Zelara's analysis with the customer's data, involve Science in novel or ambiguous analyses, and state clearly when the evidence is not decision-ready

  • Enable the customer's team to operate campaigns independently rather than becoming the person who runs them

  • Partner with the commercial lead on annual contracts, expansion, and renewal: identify the opportunity, quantify the value, and de-risk the technical plan

  • Drive the product loop rather than report into it: turn recurring customer needs into product opportunities, engineering requirements, and research questions, and bring the evidence from live accounts that decides their priority

  • Build what closes the gap in the meantime: use agents to produce the scripts, tooling, and prototypes that unblock an account before the platform covers it

Your First 90 Days

30 Days (Immersion): Learn the platform and customer portfolio, join every active account, and take ownership of your first technical customer relationship.

60 Days (Ownership): Lead one onboarding independently, with the integration requirements, campaign configuration, experiment design, and measurement plan agreed before launch.

90 Days (Scale): Own a small portfolio, deliver your first evidence-backed results readout, use it with the commercial lead to inform an annual-contract or expansion decision, and improve the playbook based on live accounts.

Who You Are

  • You have led deployments, implementations, or technical accounts for mid-market or enterprise customers at a B2B SaaS company, and your work has influenced adoption, renewal, or expansion.

  • You judge a customer's business before you design for it: which metric their leadership is measured on, which one is decoration, and what matters that nobody has said out loud. You aim the solution at the first.

  • You can turn a business question into an analysis plan: define the right metric, cohort, and measurement window; identify what would disprove the claim; and judge whether the evidence is decision-ready.

  • You have led real customer integrations and know that a successful import is not the same as usable data.

  • You understand experiments: control groups, effect sizes, statistical power, conversion windows, and why the design has to be frozen before it runs.

  • You know the lifecycle marketing stack (Braze, Bird, Iterable, Klaviyo, Customer.io, Emarsys, HubSpot): what it does well, where it stops, and how a CRM team works inside it.

  • You are credible with a Head of CRM and their data engineer in the same hour, and you switch between them without losing either.

  • You say the uncomfortable thing early, and a commitment with a date on it is a commitment.

  • You want to build the function, not only perform the role.

  • You are AI-native in how you work. A software engineering background is not a requirement. Building with agents is: the script that reshapes a customer's export, the prototype that shows a CRM team what we mean, the tooling that saves you the next ten hours.

  • You are fluent in English. German is a strong advantage given our current market focus.

Bonus

  • You have been the operator on the other side, running lifecycle or CRM programs in-house, so you know what we are asking a customer's team to change.

  • You have experience with experimentation platforms, bandits, or applied ML in production.

  • You have converted pilots or POCs into multi-year contracts and can say what actually moved the decision.

How We Work

We are an AI-first team. We use spec-driven workflows and AI-assisted execution across engineering and go-to-market, adopting what makes us faster and discarding what does not. We value evidence, speed, and clear ownership over process theater, status reporting, or activity for its own sake.

If you want to push the boundaries of how software gets delivered to customers, not just what gets delivered, you will fit right in.

What We Offer

  • Work alongside founders who have built and sold an AI-driven SaaS business and led large-scale B2C operations from the customer's side of the table.

  • A founding senior individual-contributor role in Solutions Architecture. You define the playbook now, with a path to build and lead the function as the customer base grows.

  • Autonomy over onboarding, pilots, and technical value realization, with close partnership on account growth and a tight working relationship with Product, Science, and Engineering.

  • Direct access to real customers and real production data.

  • Based in Berlin with regular travel to European customers.

  • A competitive salary and a meaningful equity stake, early enough to shape the company's direction.

  • Your choice of a Deutschlandticket or bike subscription, plus a gym/fitness club membership.

Our Compass

We are guided by four core values:

  • Seek Truth: We ground decisions in evidence. When the facts change, we change our mind.

  • Act with Integrity: We build trust through transparency, reliability, and ownership.

  • Put Customers First: We succeed only when they succeed.

  • Accelerate Impact: We prefer speed, simplicity, and real learning over ceremony.
