title: Account Executive (Advisory) - Munich (m/w/d)
description:
Get to know us

Ideals is a global B2B SaaS product company recognized as the most highly rated and customer-centric brand in the secure business collaboration market. Trusted by over 2,000,000 users from 300,000 companies globally, we help people run high-stakes processes and make important decisions with less stress, higher quality, and shorter hours.

Ideals Virtual Data Room (VDR): Secure document sharing and collaboration for due diligence, fundraising, corporate reporting, licensing, clinical trials, and other complex transactions.

Ideals Board: Board and leadership collaboration platform for faster, safer, and more compliant decision-making.

After 18 years in the market, we power more than 10% of global M&A activity, grow at 30%+ YoY, and are now scaling 5x globally to disrupt the VDR category and reach unicorn status by 2029.

The role

Ideals has been in the Virtual Data Room space since 2008 and has built a trusted reputation with clients across multiple industries in Europe, including Orcan Energy, E-Gruppe, Deloitte, and EY.

To support the growth of the Ideals VDR in Germany, we continue our expansion by adding an Account Executive (Business Development Manager) based in the Munich area to play a key role in building and deepening key accounts and long-term client partnerships across the southern German market.

As a front-line, quota-carrying team member, you will actively reach out to 30-40 new customers each month and oversee a pipeline of 50+ opportunities to close deals. Engaging proactively with C-suite and key account decision-makers across Finance, Banking, and other sectors, you will contribute directly to our growth story in the German market.

This role is for you if you're commercially driven, take full ownership of how you show up, yet are genuinely open to coaching and ways to improve. You have a collaborative mindset and treat team success as important as hitting your own number.

Compensation package: 50% base salary; 50% performance-based variable.

Why Ideals?

  • Industry-leading sales culture: Ideals ranks among the Top-5% of companies on RepVue, as rated by sales professionals. You’ll be empowered with dedicated Sales Enablement, RevOps, DACH Marketing support, and a structured onboarding ramp.

  • Stable growth: You'll join a profitable, bootstrapped SaaS company positioned to deliver 5x revenue expansion. The deals you close will directly shape Ideals' Germany footprint and feed into our global scaling ambition.

  • Sales motion built on regional nuance: You'll be part of a European-headquartered org with deep roots in the VDR business, driving GTM in a market we understand well, backed by a product that powers 10%+ of global M&A activity.

What you will do

  • Build relationships with key stakeholders and industry influencers throughout the Munich metropolitan region

  • Deliver sales targets by focusing on new customer acquisition

  • Proactively build and manage a pipeline, working with strategic German accounts and constantly developing new opportunities

  • Actively contribute to the execution of the sales and marketing strategy for the German region

  • Take part in arranging M&A Community events, enhancing Ideals' visibility

  • Deliver compelling product presentations to clients

  • Structure, negotiate, and close deals

  • Consistently share insights and provide updates to customers

  • Provide relevant customer feedback to the product development and management teams

  • Collaborate with Customer Success and Commercial Sales to grow customer satisfaction and the company's revenue

What you bring

  • 1-2 years of demonstrated experience in direct sales or business development within the B2B or professional services sector

  • Experience in high-velocity sales environments and effectively engaging with decision-makers

  • A track record of successfully managing pipelines and closing high-value deals

  • Exceptional business communication skills to structure persuasive pitches and navigate client discovery

  • Native-level proficiency in German with professional English level (C1+)

Nice to have

  • SaaS, financial, fintech, or information security industries background

  • Fluency in an additional language

What we offer

We highly value our people, so we will empower you with all the resources and support to help you reach your full potential.

For your best work

  • Hybrid flexibility to shape your ideal workday

  • Home workplace budget

  • Co-working expense coverage

  • Individual IT budget for extra equipment

  • Top-tier tech and AI-powered tools

For your growth

  • Access to Ideals Academy with numerous courses

  • Investment in external learning and development activities

  • Guidance in Personal Development Plan creation

  • Professional literature and subscriptions coverage

  • Support of your passion as a speaker or writer

  • Internal talent mobility opportunities

For your well-being

  • Tailored Wellness Package to support your physical and mental health

  • Urban Sports membership

  • Funding for sports competitions

  • 30 business days of paid time off per year

  • Paid health-related time off

Extra perks

  • Budget for meetups with your local team

  • Generous internal referral program

Our culture

Commitment, Excellence, Collaboration, Trust and Care are core values to the Ideals team. For us, these are the principles that every Idealer lives and breathes. We are on the lookout for like-minded individuals who share our values. By doing so, we create a team where talents feel at ease and work to the best of their abilities.

Discover more

Ideals is an equal opportunity employer

All qualified applicants for employment will be considered without regard to an individual’s race, color, sex, gender identity, gender expression, religion, age, national origin or ancestry, citizenship, physical disability, medical condition, family care status, marital status, domestic partner status, sexual orientation, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local laws. title: Staff Software Engineer (m/f/d) for telemedicine platform
description:
Your role at Ocumeda

As Staff Software Engineer (m/f/d) you are the engineer who makes hard, unclear or broken things tractable. You know how our platform works end to end and you shape it as you go. Your focus is our full-stack platform: the web application our doctors, our optician partners, and their customers use daily, and the services behind it.
This is an individual contributor role. No direct reports, real technical authority: you set direction on architecture and engineering practice, and you build in the same codebase as everyone else in the team. Staff/Senior here means deeper, not further from the code. Your job is to keep our systems fast to iterate, reliable in production, and ready for international expansion and scaling.

  • Own the architecture of our full-stack platform – frontend, backend, data, AWS – and evolve it under real product pressure instead of rewriting it
  • Own our testing strategy: where we invest in unit, integration and end-to-end coverage, what we deliberately do not test, and how tests stay fast enough that nobody skips them
  • Push our agentic coding practice forward: tooling, guardrails and testing discipline that make us faster without putting unverified code into a live product
  • Shape scope together with product: surface the cheap 80 % solution, and say clearly when something is not worth building
  • Build so that what ships is operable and auditable by design (e.g. ISO 27001, ISO 13485), without turning engineering into paperwork
  • Go wherever the problem is – a scaling bottleneck one week, a broken integration the next – you fix it properly


What makes you a great fit

  • Several years of professional software engineering experience (roughly 7+), most of it on systems that reached real users
  • Deeply hands-on across the stack: strong in the frontend, at home in the backend, comfortable in the infrastructure and web technologies around it
  • A strong background in TypeScript, and well-formed opinions you can defend and revise
  • A clear product focus: you care about what ships, what runs, and what users experience
  • You speak fluent English (C1); German is a plus
... and as a nice to have: 
  • Experience in a start-up or scale-up where speed and quality both mattered
  • Comfort taking ownership and shaping processes nobody has defined yet
  • A degree in a STEM field – equivalent practical experience counts more
  • Exposure to regulated software, medical devices or health data
If you match most of this, apply. We would rather read your application than have you rule yourself out.


What you can expect from us

  • Flexible working hours and hybrid work with home office options
  • Subsidized Deutschlandticket (public transport pass) for employees
  • Personal learning & development budget for trainings, conferences, and professional growth
  • High level of ownership, fast decision-making, and real opportunities to help shape the company
  • Regular feedback, short decision paths, and individual development opportunities
  • International team with close collaboration, regular exchange, and shared team events
  • Collaboration with experts from optometry, ophthalmology, software & AI development, and strategy consulting
  • Monthly contribution toward a Wellpass membership
  • Free access to Nilo Health for mental health and wellbeing
  • Competitive salary matching your role and experience
  • Modern, dog-friendly office in the heart of Munich, close to the main train station (Hauptbahnhof)
  • Contributing to a leading teleophthalmology platform that sustainably improves access to eye care

description:
Intro

Adsquare's mission is centered on:

  • Passion: Solving complex challenges with exceptional people, technology, and data.

  • Niche: Specializing in Location Intelligence for Programmatic Advertisers.


Our work is guided by our core values, and we look for candidates who embody them:

  • Drive: Turning ambition into action that brings valuable outcomes.

  • Resilience: Adapting, persevering, and growing stronger through challenges.

  • No BS: Upholding honesty, transparency, and clear communication.

  • Humble: Valuing modesty and letting results speak for themselves.

  • Moral Compass: Acting with fairness, integrity, and respect.


About the team

You'll join Adsquare's Data Products team, responsible for the pipelines and signals that power our Location Intelligence solutions. Working closely with our Lead PM for Data Products and a squad of data engineers, you'll help ingest, process, and scale the supplier and panel data that fuels our products. Your squad sits at the intersection of engineering, data governance, and downstream teams like Measurement and Activation, ensuring the signals we deliver are fast, reliable, and trustworthy.


Your Mission

As Product Owner for SDV Data Products (f/m/d), you'll own your squad's delivery, turning strategy into clear, testable backlog items while managing the technical scale of our core data pipelines. You'll be the primary technical counterpart to our data suppliers and panel partners, driving the operational reliability that keeps our signals fresh and trusted.


Your Profile

  • 3-5 years of experience as a Product Owner or technical PM, ideally in AdTech, MarTech, or another data-heavy ecosystem.

  • Strong at managing delivery and technical scale: sequencing complex backend work, mapping dependencies, and scoping against time, whether working with engineers, architects, or integration teams.

  • Operationally rigorous: comfortable thinking in SLIs, SLOs, freshness, match rate, and MTTR, not just features shipped, and skilled at running a tight, testable backlog.

  • Data-fluent, with required SQL proficiency: able to independently query internal data sources to investigate supplier data, panel quality, and pipeline KPIs, and bring quantified evidence into prioritisation.

  • Comfortable with ambiguity: able to make decisions with limited information and translate business intent clearly for engineering.

  • A privacy-aware product thinker who understands data governance and how evolving privacy frameworks affect upstream ingestion and pipeline logic.

  • A clear communicator across altitudes, able to translate strategy into specs and engineering reality into product trade-offs.

  • A true owner who drives outcomes without step-by-step direction and surfaces tensions upward rather than resolving them quietly.


What you will do

  • Own and maintain your squad's backlog, working closely with the Lead PM for Data Products to translate strategy into clear, testable user stories.

  • Lead the roadmap for modernising, scaling, and optimising our core data ingestion and processing pipelines to handle high-throughput workloads.

  • Manage internal dependencies — SLAs, schema contracts, and joint roadmap touchpoints — with downstream squads such as Measurement, Activation, and Data Products.

  • Support the Lead PM on new supplier partnerships and panel expansion through feasibility input, integration scoping, and prototype delivery.

  • Define, own, and report on operational KPIs such as signal freshness, SLA adherence, panel coverage, schema validation pass rate, and match rate.

  • Establish SLIs, SLOs, and escalation paths in partnership with engineering, and own the operational visibility layer (dashboards, alerts) that surfaces data product health.

title: Product Owner (all genders)
description:
Deine Rolle bei uns

Digitalisierung ist kein Buzzword, sondern eine Haltung.

In deiner Rolle als Product Owner (all genders) gestaltest du digitale Produkte, Prozesse und Lösungen, die echten Nutzen schaffen – für Anwender:innen, Organisationen und anspruchsvolle Projekte.

Du verantwortest die Produktvision, übersetzt Anforderungen in umsetzbare Lösungen und bringst Fachbereiche, IT, Stakeholder:innen und externe Partner:innen an einen Tisch. Dabei denkst du nicht nur agil oder klassisch – sondern situativ das, was wirklich funktioniert.


Welche Aufgaben auf dich warten

Digitale Lösungen gestalten & weiterentwickeln

  • Du entwickelst Ideen und Zielbilder für digitale Produkte, Prozesse und Lösungen.
  • Du strukturierst und priorisierst Anforderungen und übersetzt sie gemeinsam mit den Beteiligten in umsetzbare Lösungen.
  • Du begleitest digitale Lösungen über verschiedene Phasen hinweg – von der Konzeption bis zur Einführung und Weiterentwicklung.
Projekte steuern & Umsetzung begleiten
  • Du planst und koordinierst IT- und Digitalisierungsprojekte und behältst Ziele, Termine, Qualität und Ressourcen im Blick.
  • Du schaffst Transparenz über Fortschritt, Abhängigkeiten und offene Entscheidungen.
  • Du sorgst gemeinsam mit den Projektbeteiligten dafür, dass aus Konzepten funktionierende Lösungen werden.
Anforderungs‑ & Stakeholder‑Management
  • Du nimmst Anforderungen auf, hinterfragst und strukturierst sie und stimmst sie mit den relevanten Beteiligten ab.
  • Du moderierst unterschiedliche Interessen und führst Entscheidungen herbei.
  • Du begleitest Veränderungen und unterstützt dabei, neue Prozesse und Lösungen erfolgreich in der Organisation zu verankern.
Beraten & Wissen vermitteln
  • Du unterstützt bei der Bewertung und Auswahl geeigneter digitaler Lösungen und Technologien.
  • Du begleitest bei Bedarf Ausschreibungen, Angebotsbewertungen und Beschaffungsprozesse.
  • Du bereitest komplexe Themen verständlich auf und unterstützt Anwender durch Workshops, Schulungen und geeignete Materialien.


Was du mitbringst

  • mehrjährige Erfahrung in digitalen Projekten, IT-Projekten, Produktentwicklung oder vergleichbaren Rollen mit eigener Verantwortung.
  • Ein gutes Verständnis für Nutzer, Prozesse und technische Zusammenhänge.
  • Die Fähigkeit, Komplexität zu strukturieren und Entscheidungen herbeizuführen.
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (jeweils mindestens C1).
  • Hohe Reisebereitschaft (50% Anwesenheit am Standort Würzburg). 


Warum du bei uns richtig bist

Bei uns arbeitest du an Themen, die nicht nur visionär klingen, sondern die Bauwelt tatsächlich smarter und zukunftsfähig machen – und das Ganze in Projekten und mit Kund:innen, die garantiert nicht langweilig werden. Dabei bist du von Anfang bis Ende mitten im Geschehen und hast ein Team an deiner Seite, das fachlich top ist, menschlich der Knaller und jeden Partybus das Fürchten lehrt. Wir glauben an Flexibilität statt Stechuhr, an Vertrauen statt Mikromanagement und an stabile Verhältnisse. Deshalb bekommst du bei uns eine unbefristete Festanstellung in einem familienfreundlichen Umfeld mit kurzen Wegen und schnellen Entscheidungen. Außerdem warten Team‑Get‑Aways, gemeinsame Events, Hansefit, ein dickes Benefits‑Paket und eine vernünftige Altersvorsorge auf dich.

Wir bringen Kompetenz, Verantwortung, Weiterentwicklung und Humor perfekt unter einen Helm bringt..

Your responsibilities

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
About MUBI

MUBI is a global streaming service, production company and film distributor dedicated to elevating great cinema. To make this possible, we create, curate, acquire and champion visionary films, bringing them to audiences all over the world. We have a team of brilliant, dedicated and passionate people to help bring our mission to life. From London to New York, Istanbul to Paris, and Berlin to Mexico - we work together to realize MUBI’s vision.

That’s where you come in! Join our global team and help us make great cinema accessible to everyone, everywhere.

About the role

This is a senior, hands-on product role for someone who wants to own a meaningful slice of the MUBI product end-to-end, and is at their best when the problem is still ambiguous.

You’ll own the Audience & Platform Expansion domain - a critical product surface for our next phase of growth. In this role, you will be responsible for building the scalable foundation to drive global subscriber acquisition and pioneer our tiered premium offerings. You’ll own its strategy, its roadmap and its delivery, from a high-level business goal all the way to a shipped, measured feature. The hardest product problems at MUBI cross team and time-zone boundaries, and break down without someone holding the whole picture; this role exists to be that person for one of these domains.

Reporting to our Senior Product Director, this is a senior, individual contributor role. You'll lead through clarity and influence rather than headcount - aligning engineering, design and data scientists around a vision they actually believe in, and mentoring/coaching other, more junior PMs as you go. We care about craft, in the films we champion and in the products we build, so the bar is product excellence and real user impact, not shipping for its own sake.

We work hybrid-remote where we require 3 office days in Soho, London (if you're in commutable distance from London). Our core days are Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday, with the flexibility to use our offices on the remaining two days if you wish.

Where you'll have impact

You'll own a product surface that leadership relies on, translating ambiguous, evolving priorities into a roadmap teams can execute against - and giving the business a crisp, honest read on what's working, what isn't, and what needs a decision. As you build credibility through delivery, you'll set the standard for how product strategy is articulated and defended at MUBI. Concretely, you'll:

  • Translate business goals into clear, actionable product roadmaps, and own the sub-strategy for a specific MUBI area (e.g. onboarding, content/catalogue discovery, monetization, or viewer experience).

  • Guide technical products through the entire lifecycle - from conception, through development, into launch - and iterate after.

  • Partner directly with Engineering, UX/UI Design, Data Science, Marketing, Business Development and Legal to define product requirements and resolve trade-offs.

  • Establish the KPIs and OKRs for your area, and use data-backed insight to iterate quickly and demonstrate measurable impact.

  • Pitch roadmaps to senior leadership to guide resource allocation, and align engineering, design and analytics teams without relying on direct hierarchy.

  • Write narrative strategy memos and present complex visions clearly - to senior leadership and engineering teams alike.

  • Mentor other team members and raise the bar for product thinking around you.

What you'll bring

  • You've spent significant time shipping complex technical products end to end, and you're happiest owning a problem from the messy, ambiguous start rather than picking up a tidy backlog. You bring structure where there is none - a clear strategy, sharp prioritisation, honest measurement - without becoming a source of process for its own sake.

  • You're technically fluent enough to hold your own with strong engineers: you can translate an ML model, a streaming architecture or a latency constraint into a business trade-off a stakeholder can act on, and tell a real architectural limit from a convenient one.

  • You're an excellent communicator who can flex between an engineer and an executive in the same hour, equally comfortable writing a strategy memo and defending it in a leadership review.

  • You lead through influence - aligning people across functions, regions and time zones around work they want to do.

Qualifications & Expectations

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, Design, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 8+ years in product management or a closely related technical role, with at least 3–5 years focused on shipping complex technical products from 0 to 1.

  • Strong business judgment and strategic thinking - able to see the big picture and make connections across teams and issues.

  • Technical acumen: the ability to translate highly technical engineering constraints (machine learning models, streaming architectures, latency) into clear business trade-offs for non-technical stakeholders.

  • Deep domain fluency in identity and access management, subscription management, billing and monetization, and data processing - with the ability to debate architectural and technical trade-offs.

  • A proven ability to lead cross-functional teams through influence rather than direct authority.

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication, including narrative strategy writing for senior audiences.

  • Strong problem-solving, attention to detail, and the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

  • Experience with AI tools, and AI prototyping

  • A deep alignment with MUBI's culture and values: craftsmanship, product excellence, a bias toward high-impact work, and genuine respect for the user.

We want to make cinema accessible to everyone. We believe people from different backgrounds bring different ideas that foster innovation and engagement, allowing us to attract great people to develop the best experience for our users.

title: Senior Analyst - MENA focus

As a Senior Analyst covering the MENA region, you will help ExTrac understand and anticipate political and security developments across the region, including the activities of state and non-state actors, violent extremist organisations (VEOs), and the online ecosystems in which they operate. Leadership and collaboration

Innovation and capability development

  • Help develop research methodologies, monitoring frameworks, and analytical processes to improve team efficiency and product quality.

  • Integrate AI systems and AI-assisted workflows into analytical practice where they create genuine improvements.

You should apply if

  • MENA is the region you already follow closely, across its politics, security dynamics, and the violent extremist movements and online ecosystems operating within it. This is the region you want to go deeper on rather than a rotation on the way to something else.

Where this role can take you

  • Build leadership experience through mentoring junior analysts, quality-assuring their work, and supporting prioritisation across a small team.

Requirements
